newsitem.title: MEXICO: Judge jails Mexico's former drug czar.
newsitem.headline: Judge jails Mexico's former drug czar.

text.p: A judge jailed Mexico's former antinarcotics czar on Tuesday after finding sufficient evidence for him to stand trial on charges of drug corruption.

Second District Judge Armando Baez Espinoza issued the ruling against Gen. Jesus Gutierrez Rebollo, who until last week was head of Mexico's National Institute for Combatting Drugs, and two associates, the government news agency Notimex said.

Baez said Gutierrez was charged with criminal association, transportation of cocaine and receiving bribes. Authorities say he worked for Amado Carrillo Fuentes, the country's most powerful drug baron.
He has three days to appeal the ruling.
Gutierrez's arrest last week profoundly embarrassed Mexican and U.S. authorities who had previously praised him as an incorruptible figure.

It also coincided with Washington's annual review of whether Mexico and 31 other countries are cooperating with the United States in the war on illegal drugs. President Bill Clinton must "certify" before the end of the month whether Mexico is cooperating or not.
